name: bidhub-frontend
description: BidHub - Shell + Microfrontends (React + Vite + Module Federation)

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/mf-leiloes && npm run build -w apps/mf-financeiro && npm run build -w apps/shell
scripts.preview: concurrently -n leiloes,financeiro,shell "npm run preview -w apps/mf-leiloes" "npm run preview -w apps/mf-financeiro" "npm run preview -w apps/shell"
scripts.local: npm run build && npm run preview
